reason: A Feishu/Lark bridge for starting, monitoring, steering, approving, and stopping DeepSeek Harness sessions from chats, with project mapping and file or attachment exchange.

summaries.zh: 通过飞书或 Lark 会话启动、监控、控制和审批 DeepSeek Harness 任务，并支持项目映射及文件附件交互。
summaries.en: Control and monitor DeepSeek Harness tasks from Feishu or Lark conversations with project mapping, approvals, session controls, and file or attachment exchange.

capabilities: Starts and controls DeepSeek Harness tasks and sessions
Routes messages, approvals, questions, files, and images through Feishu/Lark
Sends selected workspace files back to Lark
Configures external Feishu/Lark credentials and messaging permissions
